sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽसि मम दुष्टात्मंश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः ।अद्य त्वां सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामि यमसादनम् ।। ६.१०५.१९ ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā 'si mama duṣṭātmaṁścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ ।adya tvāṁ sāyakaistīkṣṇairnayāmi yamasādanam ।। 6.105.19 ।।

translations.english: "O selfish Ravana! Today you have come in my sight by good fortune. I shall send you to the abode of Yama with my arrows."
